findings.reason: S2 requires lawful referential-only rebinding with existing child intrinsic/principal/effective-authority/credential/custody/revocation identity preserved. Frozen retained-parent qualified process/enrollment binding has no in-place ACTIVE retarget, and allowed replacement/restart requires full drain/fresh spawn/new generation/key. A recomputed parent hash does not provide that lifecycle transition.
findings.semantic_caveat: The parent value is retained approved birth captured before enrollment, not an automatic live-current-supervisor alias. It is not an authority grant, private-key derivation or custody owner. Intrinsic YES is scoped to the frozen qualified process identity component, not physical UID generation. Rejection is source-lifecycle-based, not merely syntactic tuple-hash change.

decision.required_by_S2: Retarget only reference-derived fields, preserve child intrinsic/process principal, effective authority, credentials/custody and revocation identity, with zero child substitutions
frozen_rules: Parent is measured from exact retained birth before child enrollment
Complete child process identity includes parent_identity; enrollment binds both
Parent expectation cannot be patched inside ACTIVE/sealed generation
Frozen child replacement/restart requires drain/fresh bootstrap/new generation and new key after extinction/tombstone
decision.counterexample: Fresh S_new differs from retained S_old. If candidate S2 requires child P(S_new), unchanged retained P(S_old) cannot satisfy that candidate. Canonical parent_identity does not automatically follow a live-current supervisor. Independently, the frozen lifecycle permits no S_new substitution with the old children preserved: full drain/fresh spawn is required, and no active parent-reference retarget transition exists. Recomputing a hash does not rewrite retained birth/descriptor provenance. The permitted fresh bootstrap/re-enrollment route does not preserve old child process/enrollment/generation/credential identity, so S2 conditions are not met.
decision.not_proven: No claim that parent supplies authority, shared key, or same principal; unchanged numeric UID/capability labels would not preserve current qualified identity.
decision.minimum_next_contract_gap: A separately authorized identity/lifecycle contract would have to establish lawful parent-lineage rebinding with child identity/custody/credential preservation; current frozen contract supplies no such transition. No amendment performed.

decision: Respect section4 STOP; do not create child-rebinding, seven/21-witness, matrix or final native-recomputation artifacts. No accepted S2 under current frozen identity/lifecycle contract. No next gate executed.
